paths: www.baidu.com/s (web results; also news vertical via tn=news, advanced search via tn=baiduadv)
www.baidu.com/baidu (legacy site-search form action, word/si/ct; redirects to /s; inferred from widely copied site-search snippets)
m.baidu.com/s and m.baidu.com/<key=value>/.../s, where leading path segments such as from=844b, ssid=<hex>, pu=sz@1320_480, bd_page_type=0 are tracking/session/device segments to strip
m.baidu.com/sf/vsearch (mobile video vertical; inferred by analogy with www)
news.baidu.com/ns (legacy news search; now served via www.baidu.com/s?tn=news; inferred)
NOT result pages: www.baidu.com/link?url=... (outbound click redirect; AdGuard/LUS strip eqid and wd there), www.baidu.com/s?tn=json and image.baidu.com/search/acjson (JSON APIs)

functional.name: tn
functional.meaning: Overloaded. Functional ONLY when the value selects a vertical/template: news (news vertical on /s), baiduadv (advanced search, required by q1 to q6), baiduimage (image results), vsearch (video on /sf/vsearch). Every other value (baidu, baiduhome_pg, 48020221_dg, monline_3_dg, baidutop10, iphone, SE_*, *_pg, *_dg) is a partner/account code and is non-functional.

engines.notes: Baidu publishes no URL-parameter documentation; the only first-party reference is the advanced-search form (q1 to q6, rn, lm, ct, ft, tn=baiduadv), plus Baidu UI code mirrored in the 2014 edpx-zhixin dev environment (tn = originating account, f = come-from, ct = bitfield, nojc = cancel spelling hint, mobile path segments). Live verification was impossible: on 2026-10-10 both www.baidu.com/s and m.baidu.com/s redirected unauthenticated clients to the wappass.baidu.com captcha. ClearURLs has no Baidu provider. AdGuard strips only rsv_pq, rsv_t and eqid; DandelionSprout's LUS is far more aggressive and also strips functional rn, lm, od, cl, ct (image) and tn wholesale, so CheckLink must not copy LUS blindly; tn needs a value allowlist. Baidu has no safe-search, region/market or interface-language URL parameter (Chinese-only UI; no source shows one); results language is ct (advanced) or sl_lang (search tools). Duplicate keys: if both wd and word appear, keep both (Baidu uses wd first on www; inferred). Empty-valued parameters (width=, height=, q3=) can be dropped. Keep gpc and other values byte-for-byte; do not re-encode. www.baidu.com/link?url=... is a redirect, not a canonical page.

engines.notes: Most Naver parameter semantics come straight from Naver's own result-page source (option forms and their JS handlers), fetched live on 2026-10-10, which counts as first-party; the official Search API docs confirm query/start semantics. Live A/B tests on 2026-10-10 established that qvt=0 is the only 'search as typed' switch (sm=tab_org is a label), and that sm, tqi, oquery, acq, acr, fbm and qdt do not change results. ClearURLs has no Naver provider; AdGuard strips only tqi on result pages. Keep both where and ssc: some tabs (blog, cafe) are chosen by ssc alone, others by where alone in older URLs (SearXNG sends only where). sort is overloaded: numeric for news, rel/date/playcount for video; st is the cafe sort. Naver has no safe-search, region or interface-language URL parameter: adult results are gated by login (4get: 'Naver blocks logged-out NSFW searches'). Empty-valued parameters (docid=, news_office_checked=, color=) can be dropped. Naver's own search-option guide pages are linked from each panel (e.g. https://help.naver.com/support/alias/search/integration/intergration_86.naver for images) but render client-side and were not machine-readable.
